A.name: Certified as-built + witnessed test + serial match
A.notes: Only Class A may be used as Civil Defense statutory primary evidence.

B.name: As-built + commissioning report without serial match
B.notes: Acceptable for operator PPM start; not sufficient for fire pump statutory pack.

C.name: Vendor literature / O&M only
C.notes: Cannot prove the installed asset is the one described.

D.name: Verbal, unmarked photo, or unmarked drawing

Unprovable.name: No usable evidence
Unprovable.notes: Three-valued logic: absence is Unprovable, not a silent pass.
